description: This file contains extension methods for BulkRequestDescriptor to create Elasticsearch documents from ContentItemDocumentIndex objects, including handling various data types and adding values to a dictionary.

classes.name: BulkRequestDescriptorExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for BulkRequestDescriptor to facilitate creating Elasticsearch documents from content item indexes.

methods.name: CreateElasticDocument
methods.description: Extension method that adds documents to the BulkRequestDescriptor based on a collection of ContentItemDocumentIndex objects.

methods.name: CreateElasticDocument
methods.description: Private method that converts a ContentItemDocumentIndex into a dictionary suitable for Elasticsearch, handling various data types.

methods.name: AddValue
methods.description: Helper method that adds a key-value pair to the dictionary, managing multiple values for the same key by converting to a list.
